title: Observer
prompt: Long-lived Subject holds anonymous listeners; memory grows after navigating away. What must the design include?

choices.label: Explicit unsubscribe/weak refs on teardown; document notify order
choices.consequence: Leaks and order surprises are the Observer tax.

choices.label: Ban all events
choices.consequence: Avoids the force instead of managing lifecycle.

choices.label: Wrap listener creation in an AbstractFactory
